question.text: Clearing members have irrevocably authorized clearing banks to:

answer.text: Access their clearing accounts for debiting and crediting as per clearing corporation instructions
Lend their clearing funds to other members
Use their clearing funds for bank operations

explanation.text: The Logic: Clearing members irrevocably authorize clearing banks to access their clearing accounts for debiting and crediting as per Clearing Corporation instructions. The Trap: The other options describe uses of clearing funds (investing, lending, bank operations) that the source does not authorize. Note: The authorization is described as irrevocable in the source.
